preFreshmanVerified.note: Elisha Marfil, Ashland, class of 2030. She placed 3rd at the 2026 MIAA girls All-States before her freshman year, and the tournament itself printed her grade as '8th' — which is where the class of 2030 came from, so the grade that flags this result is the same grade that dates it. The MIAA record is the authority on who wrestled, and eighth graders compete in it. The only pre-freshman placer in the state. Different from Maryland (COMAR 13A.06.03.02, grades 9-12 only) and Virginia (VHSL 28-2-1, eighth graders on junior varsity only), where the same shape proved a class year wrong (29 Oct 2026).
